title: Additional Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527)
summary: On October 29, 2026, Ivanti updated its security advisory for Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to include two additional vulnerabilities and released fixes for both. Ivanti rates CVE-2026-111357, a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability (CWE-306), with a CVSSv3.1 score of 8.8; it allows a local authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. CVE-2026-118527, classified as generation of predictable numbers or identifiers (CWE-340), has an Ivanti-assigned CVSSv3.0 score of 4.3 and, according to CISA's KEV entry, allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk.
body_markdown:
## Overview


On October 29, 2026, Ivanti


[updated its security advisory](https://hub.ivanti.com/s/article/Security-Advisory-Ivanti-Connect-Secure-CVE-2026-104935?language=en_US) for Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to include two additional vulnerabilities and released fixes for both. Ivanti rates


[CVE-2026-111357](https://www.rapid7.com/db/vulnerabilities/cve-2026-111357/) , a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability (


[CWE-306](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/306.html) ), with a CVSSv3.1 score of


[8.8](https://www.first.org/cvss/calculator/3.1#CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H) ; it allows a local authenticated attacker to escalate privileges.


[CVE-2026-118527](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-118527) , classified as generation of predictable numbers or identifiers (


[CWE-340](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/340.html) ), has an Ivanti-assigned CVSSv3.0 score of


[4.3](https://www.first.org/cvss/calculator/3.0#CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:N) and, according to


[CISA's KEV entry](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog?field_cve=CVE-2026-118527) , allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk.


Per Ivanti, exploitation in the wild has already occurred prior to disclosure, affecting a limited number of customers when these flaws are chained with


[CVE-2026-104935](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-104935) , an authentication bypass by spoofing (


[CWE-290](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/290.html) ). Rapid7


[covered the original disclosure on October 13, 2026](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/etr-ivanti-connect-secure-zero-day-exploited-in-the-wild-cve-2026-104935/) , when a fix for CVE-2026-104935 was available but the privilege escalation component remained unpatched. Fixes are now available for all three vulnerabilities.


On October 30, 2026, CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 were added to the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency's (CISA) list of


[known exploited vulnerabilities](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) (KEV), based on evidence of active exploitation.


The following scores and classifications are from Ivanti's updated advisory:

Note: The


[CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-111357) and Rapid7's vulnerability database rate CVE-2026-111357 at


[7.0](https://www.first.org/cvss/calculator/3.1#CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H) , using high attack complexity and unchanged scope. Ivanti assesses low attack complexity and changed scope, resulting in its score of 8.8. The table follows Ivanti's scores and classifications.


In its


[investigation](https://www.volexity.com/blog/2026/10/13/a-series-of-unauthenticated-events-chained-exploitation-of-ivanti-connect-secure-zero-days/) , Volexity reports that UTA0576 used an exploit chain to gain unauthenticated root access to an appliance running


22.8R2.4


, beginning on October 3, 2026. Its write-up identifies CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357; Ivanti's updated advisory identifies CVE-2026-118527 as an additional component of the chain. Volexity observed credential theft and Active Directory queries for Windows LAPS passwords and BitLocker recovery keys.


The combined impact warrants emergency remediation despite the individual CVSS ratings. Ivanti Connect Secure is an enterprise VPN solution deployed at the network edge and has a history of zero-day exploitation, including in


[2024](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/2024/01/11/etr-zero-day-exploitation-of-ivanti-connect-secure-and-policy-secure-gateways/) and


[2025](https://www.rapid7.com/blog/post/2025/01/08/etr-cve-2025-0282-ivanti-connect-secure-zero-day-exploited-in-the-wild/) .


## Mitigation guidance


Rapid7 recommends applying the available updates on an emergency basis outside of normal patching cycles. The October 13 fixes in


25.1.1.2


and


22.8R2.5


do not remediate CVE-2026-111357 or CVE-2026-118527.

22.8R2.6

25.1.3.0


and later on ISA4500, ISA6500, or ISA8500 as unaffected.


Rapid7 also recommends investigating for compromise after patching. Volexity reports that the observed activity evades Ivanti's Integrity Checker Tool, so a clean result does not rule out compromise. Preserve memory and logs before rebooting or resetting where feasible. If compromise is suspected, follow Ivanti's


[recovery steps](https://hub.ivanti.com/s/article/Recovery-Steps) and rotate potentially exposed credentials.


For current fixed versions and mitigation guidance, refer to Ivanti's


[security advisory](https://hub.ivanti.com/s/article/Security-Advisory-Ivanti-Connect-Secure-CVE-2026-104935?language=en_US) . Its linked recovery procedure includes older release references.


### Artifacts, evidence sources, and IOCs


The following guidance and artifacts are from Volexity's investigation:


**Hunting guidance:**


-


Review requests to


/dana-na/auth/url_default/welcome.cgi


, especially URL/header mismatches involving


X-DSCGI-PATH


. Observed values include:


```text
X-DSCGI-PATH: /home/webserver/htdocs/dana/fb/smb/wu.cgi
X-DSCGI-PATH: /home/runtime/tmp/<MD5(filename)>
```

Volexity also provides


[YARA rules](https://github.com/volexity/threat-intel/blob/main/2026/2026-10-13%20Ivanti/rules.yar) for request-header evidence and the privilege escalation payload in memory.


## Rapid7 customers


### Exposure Command, Vulnerability Management, and Nexpose


Exposure Command, Vulnerability Management, and Nexpose customers can assess exposure to CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 with authenticated vulnerability checks available since the 2026-10-30 content release.
